remarks: Available SHORT OR LONG TERM! This newly renovated 4 bedroom home has lovely landscaping and a large flat rear yard, is located on a quiet street near train, shops, schools, and parks. The main floor includes newly renovated eat in kitchen with cathedral ceiling, a formal dining room, living room with wood burning fireplace and bookcases, family room with vaulted ceiling and skylight and sliders to a spacious deck. The 2 main floor bedrooms each have newly renovated baths. Second floor includes a spacious Master suite with separate sitting room/office space plus 4th bedroom with skylight. Ground level has direct access to the level rear yard and to the garage. It includes a flexible space that could be good for an exercise area, a great ,laundry/mudroom with storage, sink and 2nd fridge/freezer and 1 car garage with electric car charger. New water heater. Large deck off family room has a direct gas line. Hardwood flooring throughout main floors. Ground floor has tile. Plenty of storage space.  Dogs are allowed. No cats. Owner is responsible for landscaping maintenance. Tenant pays all other expenses.
